elements.text: 3.0 DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.1 General:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Unless inconsistent with this specification, the supplier’s standard or usual
construction is desired. The equipment shall be capable of safe, proper and continuous
operation.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.2 Electric Supply:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The available system of electric supply is 415 volts between phases and 230 volts
between phase and neutral - 3 phase 4 wire A C 50 Hz system. The amount of
power required for elevators and equipment shall be indicated in the tender in the
relevant format. Power shall be provided at one point in distribution board near
to the lift shaft &a point to be indicated by the tenderer/bidder. Beyond this
supply point, all subsequent electrical systems shall be the responsibility of the
tenderer/bidder.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.3 Driving Mechanism:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.3.1 Lift Machine:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a. The lift machine shall be suitable for 415 volt, 3 phase 50 Hz AC supply with
a voltage variation of +10% and -10% and shall be placed directly above the hoist way
on steel beams resting on machine room floor slab.
b. The lift machine shall have high efficiency and low power consumption
and shall be designed to withstand peak currents in lift duties. Resilient
anti vibration mountings of suitable design shall be provided to minimize noise
and vibration transmission.
c. The lift machine shall be gearless type and consist of a motor,
electromechanical brake, and sheave all completely mounted on a common
bed plate. Roller bearings shall be provided for the sheave shaft to ensure
alignment and long bearing life or as per manufacturer’s standard proven
design. The hard alloy cast iron or steel sheave shall have rope grooves to ensure
proper traction and minimum rope wear. Adequate means of lubrication shall be
provided for all bearings.
d. Means for manual operation of the lift car shall be made by providing winding wheel
suitably marked to indicate the direction of the movement to enable the lift car to
be brought to the nearest landing. There shall be a warning display for
switching off electrical supply before the manual operations.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.3.2 Brake:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The electromagnetic brake shall be spring applied and electrically released. It shall
come into action after the lift has come to a complete halt to hold the car in position. The
brake shall operate automatically with the safety devices and failure of the mains.
It shall be released electrically. It shall be possible to release the brake manually
- such release requiring the action of manual force to move the lift in short stops.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.3.3 Drive Motor:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
(a) The drive motor shall be Permanent magnet motor suitable to withstand frequent
peak current encountered in lift duty and shall have high starting torque and low
starting current.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
(b) The motor shall be capable of not less than 180 starts per hour without
excessive temperature rise.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
(c) The maximum temperature rise of the winding shall not exceed 450C above
ambient temperature when operated under normal condition.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
(d) The motor shall carry a nameplate giving full details of its ratings
and characteristics.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
(e) The motor used shall have Class F insulation and shall be designed for 110% of
rated load.3.4
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: CONTROL:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.4.1 The lifts shall have microprocessor based, simplex/duplex, selective collective
controlled AC variable voltage variable frequency (ACVVVF) drive with closed loop control
system. The drive system shall control the starting, stopping, direction of
motion, running of the lift motor and application of the brake and/or safety
devices in t h e event of power failure or any other emergency. It shall be so
designed as to ensure a smooth and constant acceleration and retardation under
all operating conditions.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.4.2 The controller shall be wall/floor mounted, vertical, totally e n c l o s e d
cubicle type with hinged doors on the front to provide easy access to all components in
the controller. The cubicle shall be well ventilated such that the temperature
inside never exceeds the safe limits of the components at ambient room
conditions in the machine room.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.4.3 The Controller shall be complete with built in protection against the
following:
a) Over current
b) Under voltage
c) Over voltage
d) Single phasing
e) Phase reversal
f) Earth leakage
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.4.4 The controller shall be designed to cut off the power supply, apply the brake and
bring the car to a rest in the event of any of the above failures occurring.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.4.5 The tenderer/bidder shall state clearly the forms of protection
provided for each equipment.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.5 COUNTER WEIGHT:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Counterweight shall consist of cast iron weights as per manufacturer’s standards,
contained in a structural frame and shall be equal to the weight of the car
plus approximately 50% of the contract load. Suitable metallic counterweight
guard of required length shall be provided at the bottom of the hoist way
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.6 GUIDE RAIL AND GUIDES:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Guide rails of the car and counterweights shall be preferably machined section and
comprise of steel toes and grooved fish plates & bolts at the ends and securely
fastened to the hoist way frame by heavy steel brackets. Car and counterweight
frames shall be provided with suitable lubricating system. The guide rails of the
lift shall be fastened to the shaft way frame work and concrete inserts at
regular intervals. Adequate packing shall be supplied by the supplier.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.7 HOIST ROPES:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The car and counterweight shall be suspended by steel wire ropes or polyurethane flat
belt with steel wires embedded in it. The rope /belt shall be of continuous length
without break or lengthened by splicing.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
More than two independent wire ropes shall be used for cage and counterweight with
traction drive and each of the drum drives and wire ropes shall be fixed
independently to cage and counterweight. Factor of safety for normal working to be
taken as 10.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.8 LIFT CAR:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.8.1(A) Car platform & flooring for all lift Size of car platform shall be of maximum
size that could be accommodated in lift well as per code of practice. The platform
shall consist o f a structural steel frame designed on the basis of rated load
covered with a M.S steel plate with the PVC Vinyl floor. The design, colour and quality
approved by Engineer- in- charge, shall be laid on and securely fixed to the steel
sub-flooring in the approved manner. Temporary wooden platform may be provided
over PVC Vinyl flooring for protection, during the construction period.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.8.2 Top of car shall be designed to support weight of two (2) persons.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.8.3 The car enclosure for Passenger lifts shall be of stainless steel sheet of
Grade 304, 18 SWG thick, brush finish, smooth and free from defects including
standard size of 12mm thick toughen glass panel in back side of car with hand rail on 3
sides and all hardware fittings in s/s. etc.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.8.4 SS Handrail and SS kick plate of manufacturer’s standard design shall be provided
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: with the approval of Engineer-in-charge.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.8.5 On the top of the car cage following accessories should be provided:-
a. Up, down & stop push button, & one number single phase 230 V power point.
b. A travelling screen (toe guard apron) as per manufacturers design shall
be provided below the level of the car floor to prevent fall of person in the shaft
from open doorway entrance.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.8.6 Auto fan off facility shall be provided, when car is in parking
position.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.9 CAR DOORS:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.9.1 The car doors for Passenger lifts of Lecture theatre complex shall be
provided with Centre opening, horizontal sliding fire rated full Glass Doors with
elegant stainless- s tee l frame of Grade 304, in brush / hairline finish with sandwich
construction.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.9.2 The doors shall have automatic Centre opening & closing feature. Doors shall
have clear opening as per specific requirements. Infra red sensor along the entire
door height shall be provided for sensing obstruction while door closing. Also,
protective leading-edge device, as a backup to infra red sensor, shall be provided,
to open the door immediately on sensing impact on the door.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.9.3 All the car doors shall have a fire resistance of not less than 1 hour.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.10 HOIST WAY LANDING DOORS:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.10.1 The Hoist Way landing doors for Passenger lift shall be provided at each
landing with Centre opening, horizontal sliding Toughened Glass Door having elegant
stainless-steel frame of Grade 304, in brush /hairline finish with sandwich
construction.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.10.2 The doors shall have automatic opening and closing feature in association with
car door. Doors shall have a clear opening as per specific requirements. Car will open in
front only.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.10.3 Provision for emergency opening of the landing door by means of a
special key should be provided at all floors.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.10.4 All the landing doors shall have a fire resistance of not less than
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 1 hour.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.11 CAR & HOIST WAY OPERATIONS:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.11.1 The equipment shall be complete with electric door operator with AC VVVF
drive for opening and closing of Car & Hoist way landing door. The equipment shall
consist of a motor on the lift car to operate the door when the car is stopping at a
landing. The Car & Hoist way doors shall be mechanically connected such that
both move simultaneously for opening and closing.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.11.2 The Hoist way landing door shall be provided with an interlock such
that:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a) It shall not be possible for the car to be started or kept in motion until all the
landing doors and the car door are locked in the closed position.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
b) It shall not be possible to open the landing door from the landing unless the
lift car is within the particular landing zone.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
c) The car doors & Hoist way landing doors open automatically as the car is
stopping at a landing. The closing of the car and landing door must occur before the car
is set in motion.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.12 Cabin fan/Ventilation:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.12.1 Pressure fan of approved make and of adequate size shall be provided in
the car ceiling. The fan shall be on emergency supply through battery for minimum 30
min back up in case of power failure in each elevator car.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.12.2 Auto fan off facility shall be provided, when the car is in parking
mode.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.12.3 Tenderer / Bidder should indicate whether forced ventilation will be
required in the machine room for control panel and control equipment etc.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.13 Lighting:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.13.1 LED Light fixture of approved type and quality shall be provided in the car to
provide adequate lighting in the car.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.13.2 Auto light off facility shall not be provided, when the car is in parking
mode.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.13.3 Suitable outlets shall be provided on the top and bottom of the lift car to install a
hand lamp during maintenance.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.14 Emergency Light: An emergency light unit using sealed Nickel/Cadmium of
equivalent approved makes maintenance free battery power pack with charger/inverter
and compact fluorescent lamp to operate automatically and to illuminate the car for
minimum 30 minutes in case of power failure shall be provided in each lift car.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.15 Alarm Bell:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.15.1 An emergency alarm bell, including wiring shall be provided and connected
to a plainly marked push button in the car operating panel. The alarm shall be
located in the Control and the Security Room and main lift lobby.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.15.2 The alarm unit shall be solid-state siren type, operated by
Nickel/Cadmium maintenance free batteries to give a waxing and waning siren when
the alarm button in the car is pressed momentarily.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.16 Name plate:
A name plate shall be fitted in the lift car to indicate the rated capacity of the
lift & instructions in Hindi & English as per format given in specifications.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.17 OPERATION BUTTONS & INDICATIONS:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: The following operation buttons and indications shall be provided:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.17.1 In each Lift Car:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Stainless steel panel (COP) of suitable thickness flush mounted shall be provided on one
side of the door having:-
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a. LED luminated push buttons of microprocessor t y p e or touch sensitive
glass type corresponding to the floors served. Also all the buttons on the COP
shall have Braille inscription.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: b. Door open button.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: c. Door Close button.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: d. Emergency alarm button
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: e. Emergency Light
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
f. Two position key operated switch for 'with attendant' and 'without attendant'
operation.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
g. Ventilation fan ON/OFF switch with auto OFF when car is in parking
mode/there are no calls to attend.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
h. Built in intercom of the hands-free type. Provision only for providing EPABX
telephone instrument with cable shall also be kept. Also, one number
telephone instrument in machine room and one in security room including
interconnections.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: i. Dynamic car direction display
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: j. Car position indicator
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: k. Overload warning indicator
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.17.2 At Landings:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The landing fixtures shall be recess mounted on a base junction b o x i n t h e
wall by the side or on top of landing doors as required.
Each landing fixtures shall consist of micro touch type landing call buttons or
touch sensitive glass with illuminated call acknowledge signal and illuminated
digital type car position indicators on separate stainless steel face panels with
brush /hairline finish. The call buttons shall have Braille inscription. At every
landing arrival digital car position indicator with gong in indication shall be
provided.
The following landing fixtures shall be provided for each lift:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: a) Lowest floor
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Up call button
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Digital car position indicators
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Travel direction indicators
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: b) All floors other than lowest and top most floors
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Button up and down call buttons
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Travel direction indicators
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Digital car position indicators
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Manual by pass key switch for lift landings.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: c) The top most floor

elements.text: • Down call button
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Travel direction indictors
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Digital car position indicators
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: • Manual by pass key switch for lift landings.

elements.text: 3.18 Control Cabinet (Panel) Construction Feature:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a. The design of control cabinet to be done keeping in consideration of Machine room
less lift and shall be sheet steel enclosure of min. 1.6mm thick and shall be dust
weather and vermin proof type Sheet steel used shall be of adequate thickness
and properly braced to prevent wobbling.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
b. Control cabinets shall be free standing floor mounting type with anti-
vibratory pads.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
c. Control cabinets shall be provided with a concealed hinged door with
padlocking arrangement.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
d. All doors, removable covers and plates shall be gasketed all around
with neoprene
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
gaskets, louvers when provided shall have screens and filters. The screen shall be
of fine wire mesh of brass.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
e. Cable entries shall be either from top or from
bottom.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: f. All sheets steel work shall be given standard seven tank treatment and powder
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
coated both inside and outside. The colour of the finishing coat shall be as per
IS:5 and as approved by Engineer-in-charge.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.19 Cabinet Internal wiring:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.19.1 Control cabinets shall be supplied completely wired ready for Dept. /Users
external connection at the terminal blocks. All wiring shall be wired with
stranded copper conductor with FRLS properties of adequate sizes to suit the rated
circuit current. The control alarm and indication circuits shall be wired with stranded
copper conductor of sizes not smaller than 1.5 sq.mm or as per manufacturer’s
standards.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.19.2 Engraved core identification ferrules, marked to correspond with the wiring
diagram shall be fitted at both ends of each wire Ferrules shall be fit tightly on the wires
and shall not fall off when the wires are removed. Spare auxiliary contacts of all
relays, contactors, etc. shall be wired to terminal blocks. All wiring shall be
terminated on terminal blocks using solder less crimping type tinned copper lugs.
Insulated sleeves shall be provided at all the wire termination. All wiring shall be
neatly bunched and dressed without affecting access to equipment mounted within the
cabinet. Wiring trough shall be provided for vertical cabinet wiring and for
interconnecting wire between front and rear section of the cabinet.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.19.3 Terminal blocks for control indication etc. shall be suitable for
connecting to conductors of Dept./Users cables of following sizes :
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: a) Control circuits shall be min. 1.5 sq.mm multi stranded copper conductor.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: b) CT circuits: min 2.5 sq.mm multi stranded copper conductor.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Terminal blocks shall be numbered for identification and grouped according to
function. Terminal block for CT secondary leads shall be provided with short
circuiting and earthing facilities.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.20 Labels:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
All door mounted equipment as well as equipment mounted inside t h e c o
n t r o l cabinet shall be provided with individual labels, with equipment
designation engraved. Also the control cabinet shall be provided on the
front with a label engraved with designation of the control cabinet as furnished
by Engineer-in-charge.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.21 Earthing terminals:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Control cabinet shall be provided with two separate earthing terminals suitable
to receive earthing conductors as per incoming cable size.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.22 Earthing:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The equipment supplied shall be earthed with the following arrangement as per
provisions of Indian electricity rules.
a. For equipment grounding the following sizes of copper conductor shall be
used. The grounding pads and clamps provided shall be suitable for these conductors.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
i. Machine of rating 20 KW to 75 KW– 25 x 3mm tinned copper strip
ii.Machines of rating up to 20 KW- 8 SWG tinned copper conductor.
iii. Control panel – As per incoming cable size.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: b. Two independent grounding pads at appropriate end shall be provided on the
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: frame of motors, winding machine, the frame of the control panels etc.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
c. The exposed metal parts of electrical apparatus installed in a lift car shall be
sufficiently bonded and earthed.
d. One side of the secondary winding of all transformers and their cases shall be
earthed.
e. Flexible and screwed conduits shall be properly earthed.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23 SAFETY DEVICES :
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The following minimum safety devices shall be provided, including all
requirements of electrical/mechanical nature as per lift inspector.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.1 Self Levelling :0
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: The lift shall be provided with a self levelling feature within ± 5 mm.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.2 Terminal and Final Limits:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Terminal limit switches shall be provided to slow down and stop the car
automatically at the terminal landings, and final limit switches shall be furnished
to automatically cut off power should the car travel beyond the terminal landings.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.3 Terminal Buffers:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Suitable spring buffers shall be installed/ mounted on steel channels as a means of
stopping the car & counterweight.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.4 Interlocking:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
Adequate interlocking is to be provided so that the car shall not move if the landing
doors are even partially open and also the lift is overloaded.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.5 Car Safety and Governor:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The car safety shall be provided to stop the car whenever excessive descending
speed is attained as per IS.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.23.6 Automatic Rescue Device (ARD):
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
ARD w i t h batteries shall be provided for the lift other than FIRE
elevator, for rescue of passengers, in event of power failure.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 3.24 FIREMAN SWITCH:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.24.1 Each independent lift shall have a Fireman switch with glass front for
access by the Firemen. The operation of this switch shall cancel all calls to this lift and
will stop at the next nearest landing if travelling upwards. The doors will not open at
this landing and the lift will return to the ground floor. In case the lift is travelling
downwards when the fireman's switch is operated it will go straight to the ground floor
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
by passing all calls enroute. The emergency stop button inside the car shall be rendered
inoperative.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
3.24.2 The fireman’s switch shall be located adjacent to the lift opening at the
lowest terminal floor and shall be at a height of approximately 2 m above the floor
level.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 4.1 Tests at Site:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
After assembly and erection at site, the lift shall be tested at site before it is put
into normal service. The supplier shall be fully responsible for carrying out all the
tests including following as listed below in addition to the relevant Indian Standards.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a) Levelling tests
b) Safety gear test
c) Contract speed
d) Lift balance.
e) Car and landing doors locks.
f) Controller.
g) Normal terminal stopping switches.
h) Final terminal stopping switches.
i) Insulation resistance
j) Earthing
k) Ropes
l) Buffers
m) Service temperature rise test.
n) Over load test.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
The reports of the aforesaid tests shall be submitted to the Engineer-in-
charge. The contractor shall have to obtain necessary clearance from the lift
inspector and fire brigade authorities after the complete installation. It will be the
responsibility of the lift contractor to get the installation inspected and passed
by the Government Inspector for lifts. Any modification as suggested by
inspector for lifts shall be attended by the lift supplier at no extra cost to the
department.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text: 5.0 Drawings & data:
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
After award of work, the bidder shall furnish the following drawings and data for scrutiny.
All the comments on drawings shall be incorporated without financial burden to
department.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
a. Control cabinet general arrangement drawing showing plan, front view, foundation
details, inside view, terminal block location etc.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
b. Schematic wiring diagram of the control
cabinet.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES

elements.text:
c. Bill of material listing, equipment designation, makes, type rating etc. of
the various equipment mounted on the control cabinet.
section_path: WIRING IN CONDUITS AND INSTALLATIONS OF FITTINGS / FIXTURES
